text.en:
Item 34, page 95, subparagraph 24, for the Province of Isabela, paragraph "a", Title B, Section one of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred one is hereby amended to read as follows:
"34. Masigun Bridge, (Masigun Creek), Burgos cons­truction 40,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
